mLocKeys.keySummary: Yunara's Critical Strikes deal bonus magic damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Yunara's Critical Strikes deal an additional <magicDamage>@Calc_Damage_Amp@ magic damage</magicDamage>.

mBuff.mDescription:
The Wonderful and Dynamic Prayer BeadThis unit has been Slowed by Yunara's Arc of Judgment.

“Take this prayer bead and eat it.” – Yunara

Going Somewhere?This unit has been Slowed by Yunara's Arc of Ruin.

“All according to Kinkou-ku!” – Yunara (Kinkou-ku means way of the Kinkou)

Keep Up!Yunara is dashing.

“Every journey begins with a single step. But a fight begins when you catch me.” – Yunara

Must Go Fast!Yunara has increased Move Speed and is Ghosted

“You thought you could outrun me!” – Yunara

mLocKeys.keySummary: Yunara gains Move Speed and becomes Ghosted. While in her Transcendent State she instead dashes in a direction.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Yunara gains @Calc_Move_Speed@ Move Speed, increased to @Calc_Move_Speed_Enhanced@ Move Speed when moving toward an enemy champion, for @Buff_Duration@ seconds.

Transcendent State - {{Spell_YunaraE2_Name}}: Yunara dashes in a direction.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>{{Spell_YunaraE1_Name}} causes Yunara to become <keyword>Ghosted</keyword>. {{Spell_YunaraE2_Name}} gains the benefits of an Ultimate Ability.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription:
Too EarlyYunara gains Attack Speed, bonus damage On-Hit, and her Attacks spread to nearby enemies.

“You're a thousand years too early for this fight.” – Yunara

mLocKeys.keySummary: Yunara gains Attack Speed, bonus damage On-Hit, and her Attacks spread to nearby enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Yunara deal @Calc_Passive_Damage@ magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit and attacking grants @Resource_Nonchampion@ Unleash (@Resource_Champion@ Unleash for champions).

Active: Yunara consumes @Resource_Max@ Unleash and for @Buff_Duration@ seconds gains @Calc_Attack_Speed@ Attack Speed and deals an additional @Calc_Damage@ magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit. During this time, her Attacks spread to nearby enemies dealing them @Calc_Damage_Spread@ physical damage.

Transcendent State: This Ability is instantly activated for @Spell.YunaraR:Buff_Duration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Passive:Yunara's Attacks deal an additional @Calc_Passive_Damage@ magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit. Launching an Attack grants @Resource_Nonchampion@ Unleash (@Resource_Champion@ Unleash when attacking champions) for @Resource_Duration@ seconds (max: @Resource_Max@ Unleash). Not attacking for @Resource_Duration@ seconds causes Yunara to lose @Resource_Loss@ Unleash every @Resource_Loss_Interval@ seconds.

Active: Yunara consumes @Resource_Max@ Unleash, and for @Buff_Duration@ seconds gains @Calc_Attack_Speed@ Attack Speed and deals an additional @Calc_Damage@ magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit. During this time, her Attacks spread to nearby enemies dealing them @Calc_Damage_Spread@ physical damage.

Transcendent State: This Ability is instantly activated for @Spell.YunaraR:Buff_Duration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Spread Attacks can Strike Critically and apply <OnHit>%i:OnHit% On-Hit</OnHit> effects at @Spread_Onhit_Efficacy*100@% effectiveness. Damage from spread Attacks deal @Calc_Minion_Execute_Amp@ damage to minions below <scaleHealth>@Calc_Minion_Execute_Threshold@ Health</scaleHealth>.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription:
Even Further BeyondYunara's abilities are empowered.

“Congratulations, you work for The Kinkou Order now.” – Yunara

mLocKeys.keySummary: Yunara enters a Transcendent State that upgrades her basic Abilities.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Yunara enters a <keywordMajor>Transcendent State</keywordMajor> for @Buff_Duration@ seconds upgrading her basic Abilities for the duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended: Yunara enters a <keywordMajor>Transcendent State</keywordMajor> for @Buff_Duration@ seconds; <spellName>{{Spell_YunaraQ_Name}}</spellName> is instantly activated for the duration, <spellName>{{Spell_YunaraW1_Name}}</spellName> is upgraded to <keywordMajor>{{Spell_YunaraW2_Name}}</keywordMajor> and has its Cooldown reduced by @Calc_RW_Cooldown_Reduction@, and <spellName>{{Spell_YunaraE1_Name}}</spellName> is upgraded to <keywordMajor>{{Spell_YunaraE2_Name}}</keywordMajor> and has its Cooldown refreshed.

mLocKeys.keyName: Arc of Judgment | Arc of Ruin
mLocKeys.keySummary: Yunara fires a spinning prayer bead that deals damage and slows enemies. While in her Transcendent State she instead fires off a laser that deals damage and slows enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Yunara lets rip a prayer bead that deals @Calc_Damage_Initial@ magic damage and Slows by @Calc_Slow@ decaying over @Slow_Duration@ seconds. It deals an additional @Calc_Damage_Per_Second@ magic damage per second.

Transcendent State - {{Spell_YunaraW2_Name}}: Yunara fires a laser that deals @Spell.YunaraR:Calc_RW_Damage@ magic damage and Slows by @Spell.YunaraR:Calc_RW_Slow_Amount@ decaying over @Spell.YunaraR:RW_Slow_Duration@ second.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Yunara lets rip a spinning prayer bead that slows down when near enemies. It lingers and expands when it reaches its end point. Its initial hit deals @Calc_Damage_Initial@ magic damage and Slows by @Calc_Slow@ decaying over @Slow_Duration@ seconds. It deals an additional @Calc_Damage_Per_Second@ magic damage per second.

Transcendent State - {{Spell_YunaraW2_Name}}: Yunara fires a laser that deals @Spell.YunaraR:Calc_RW_Damage@ magic damage and Slows by @Spell.YunaraR:Calc_RW_Slow_Amount@ decaying over @Spell.YunaraR:RW_Slow_Duration@ second.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Cast time scales with permanent <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed> (@f3.0@% / @Cast_Time_Attack_Speed_Cap_Empowered@%). {{Spell_YunaraW1_Name}} deals @Calc_Minion_Damage_Mod@ damage to minions and its tick damage executes low health minions. {{Spell_YunaraW2_Name}} gains the benefits of an Ultimate Ability.</rules>
